english.title: Did an act whereby the safety / security / integrity of the Croydon Tramlink System / a person was endangered
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally or recklessly

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY WHAT WAS DONE..)]_
(B)_[permitted **(..SPECIFY WHAT WAS DONE..) to be done]_

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 12(4)(b) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
